title: Large Language Model-Empowered Intelligent Agent for Adaptive Fast-Charging Control of Lithium-Ion Batteries
abstract: arXiv:2611.18140v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fast charging of lithium-ion batteries is a multi-objective control problem that requires reducing charging time and sustaining high energy throughput while suppressing accelerated degradation and safety-critical electrochemical reactions. Conventional protocols are easy to implement but have limited ability to adapt to variations in battery chemistry, operating conditions, and aging state. Model-based optimization and conventional data-driven control often require accurate models, costly iterative search, or task-specific policies. We develop a large language model (LLM)-empowered intelligent agent for adaptive battery fast-charging control. In this closed-loop framework, the agent interprets structured battery states, generates executable charging actions, observes the resulting battery response, and continuously adjusts subsequent decisions. translated_title: 大语言模型赋能的智能体用于锂电池自适应快充控制
translated_abstract: 锂电池快充是一个多目标控制问题，需要在缩短充电时间、维持高能量吞吐量的同时，抑制加速老化和涉及安全的关键电化学反应。传统充电协议易于实现，但在适应电池化学体系、运行工况和老化状态变化方面的能力有限。基于模型的优化和传统数据驱动控制通常需要精确的模型、高昂的迭代搜索成本或针对特定任务的策略。我们开发了一种由大语言模型（LLM）赋能的智能体，用于电池自适应快充控制。在这一闭环框架中，智能体解析结构化的电池状态、生成可执行的充电动作、观察由此产生的电池响应，并持续调整后续决策。我们利用PyBaMM构建了一个涵盖五种电池化学体系的大规模仿真语料库……
tldr: 本文提出了一种由大语言模型赋能的智能体闭环框架，可自适应地控制锂电池快充，在缩短充电时间的同时兼顾抑制电池老化与安全性，克服了传统协议、模型优化和常规数据驱动控制方法的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-empowered intelligent agent operating in a closed-loop framework for adaptive lithium-ion battery fast-charging control, balancing charging speed with degradation suppression and safety while overcoming the limitations of conventional protocols, model-based optimization, and conventional data-driven control.
